name: alwaysdata Free Web Hosting
free_limit: Free-for-life personal website hosting: 1 GB shared SSD space, 256 MB RAM, quarter CPU core, and 3 days of backups on an alwaysdata.net address.
watch_out: Free plan is non-commercial and websites are restricted to the alwaysdata.net address; cannot run independent services. Disk quota is shared by website files, mail and databases. Paid Plus is separate; card requirement not confirmed.
